terminology.meaning: One ordered slice of the 2026-08-19 execution program, run as a single wrapper OAT project.
One phase of the wave, executed in its own worktree against exactly one external plan.
The immutable source document that is a lane's entire implementation contract.
One version increment applied to all five public packages together.

portfolio.draft: One navigational hub for the completed Wave 1 wrapper project. Open with the outcome and current state, then cover the original request and its constraints, the four decisions that materially changed the result, the as-built flow from the execution program to main with an inline architecture diagram, an implementation evidence table with commit references, a validation evidence table with commands, observed results and limits, and a closing outcome split into what works, what did not ship and what the next reader should do.
portfolio.visualIntent: Editorial hub. One dominant serif title, a short framing statement and a four-tile status strip in the first viewport, then deliberately varied section treatments: a numbered constraint list, a numbered decision ledger with reason and consequence pairs, a bounded-scroll inline SVG flow diagram with branch, fan-in and one dashed review-feedback edge, two evidence tables in scroll containers, and a three-rail outcome block. No repeated card treatment across sections.
